page: Microsoft Azure FX96-48mds_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the FXmdsv2 family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server is configured with 1832.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 38.17 GB per core.

For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 5669 GB NVMe SSD. It is also premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. This server configuration does not include any graphics processing units and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of memory relative to the dedicated CPU cores, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require proportional scaling of compute resources. The large local NVMe storage combined with the massive memory footprint makes this instance suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy enterprise applications, and complex data processing pipelines.
description: The Microsoft Azure FX96-48mds_v2 is a memory-optimized server from the FXmdsv2 family, designed for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture with an Intel processor and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V, it provides 48 dedicated vCPUs and a substantial 1832.0 GB of RAM, translating to 38.17 GB of memory per core. Storage needs are met by a bundled 5669 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance is premium storage capable. There are no onboard GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This hardware profile is engineered for memory-heavy operations, offering high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive RAM allocations relative to compute power. It is highly suited for large in-memory databases, data warehousing, and demanding enterprise applications.
